name: Win Loss Insights
description: Monthly win/loss intelligence report, as an Attention agent-builder flow: schedule (weekly) -> askAttention (pull closed deals over the trailing 30 days, analyze won and lost cohorts, compare to prior period, write the report) -> post to a channel. CONFIRM against your builder before import: the Kiki sample this was modeled on is a per-call agent, so three things here are best-effort and flagged in win-loss-insights.md -> Build notes: (1) the @activepieces/piece-schedule trigger + version, (2) the askAttention context scope for a cross-deal/CRM query, (3) the Slack channel-post action name. Set connections and the placeholder ids (<...>) on import.

nextAction.name: analyze_win_loss
nextAction.displayName: Pull closed deals, analyze won and lost cohorts, write the report

input.prompt: You are the Win Loss Insights agent. Although you run weekly, analyze the trailing 30 days. (1) List every deal closed-won or closed-lost in the past 30 days with account, outcome, rep, value if known, and cycle length if determinable. If stages are not exposed, infer outcomes from call context. (2) Pull the calls for each closed deal, grouped by deal. (3) Analyze won and lost cohorts SEPARATELY across five dimensions: Win Themes, Loss Themes, Competitive Dynamics, Sales Cycle Patterns, Pricing Sensitivity. (4) Repeat for the prior 30-day window (days 31-60 ago) and compare: win-rate trend, theme shifts, competitive shifts, cycle-length change. (5) Produce 3-5 strategic recommendations with rationale. Output the exact report format in win-loss-insights.md -> Output (executive summary, win themes, loss themes, competitive table, sales-cycle patterns, pricing insights, recommendations, trend vs prior period, source line). Edge cases: if fewer than 3 closed deals, flag the small sample; if no losses, report wins only and note loss analysis resumes when data is available; if no prior-period data, omit trend comparisons. Apply humanizer rules: no em dashes, no AI throat-clearing, no hype, one clear ask.

nextAction.name: post_report
nextAction.displayName: Post the monthly report to the team channel
